recipes.name: Octopus slices with sesame dipping sauce (Muneo-sukhoe: 문어숙회)
instructions: tammyd quebec/canada joined 5/17 & has 1 commentPosted May 26th, 2017 at 11:16 am | Reply to this comment or create a profile.hi! can anyone help me? i bought and cooked a small octopus today from the frozen departement of the super market ( the fresh one were not so fresh) it was 1.5 pound so i cooked it for 6-7 min but it had a weird layer under the skin…like a fat layer, is that possible? i tried to let one tentacle in the boiling water for 12 min to see if it was just because it was undercook but it didnt change anything…? could it really be a fat layer or is it something else?
geckos Oregon joined 5/18 & has 5 commentsPosted July 7th, 2020 at 3:28 pm | Reply to this comment or create a profile.There is a layer of gelatin.

objeanobi Bergen County, NJ joined 2/17 & has 2 commentsPosted February 21st, 2017 at 4:36 pm | Reply to this comment or create a profile.Thank you for bringing me back to my parents’ roots! … Most Moonuh in Hanareum is sold pre-cooked. Would you suggest flash boiling and then cooling again? Or just slice and serve cold?

Maangchi New York City joined 8/08 & has 10,892 commentsPosted March 1st, 2017 at 9:37 am | Reply to this comment or create a profile.I would blanch it for a minute in a little salty boiling water before serving.

Demetrio lugo, spain joined 2/17 & has 1 commentPosted February 20th, 2017 at 2:51 pm | Reply to this comment or create a profile.Hi Maangchi, this octopus is very good looking. I write to you from Galicia (Spain) where the octopus is eaten a lot and I tell you how we do it for you to try it: You cut the octopus as you know how to do it, sliced ​​in wheel on the plate You pour coarse salt You pour olive oil And at the end spicy hot paprika. I hope you like it a lotDemetrio
snowberry HongKong joined 11/11 & has 3 commentsPosted January 15th, 2017 at 11:29 am | Reply to this comment or create a profile.Just wondering how much is this huge octopus costs you? :)

alleynecarlinda Singapore joined 1/17 & has 1 commentPosted January 1st, 2017 at 1:15 pm | Reply to this comment or create a profile.Hi Maangchi! I bought octopus sashimi and ate it with the sesame dipping sauce, it was so delicious! so much better than eating it with soy sauce and wasabi! i think this is my new favorite snack!
stonefly Olympia WA joined 11/11 & has 62 commentsPosted December 27th, 2016 at 11:40 pm | Reply to this comment or create a profile.Beautiful dish (octopus and Maangchi)!!! Can’t wait to try it!
